# How Kailash is built {#build-model}

Kailash is built declaratively from **two Nix repositories with a
clean contract** ([the spec's architecture chapter](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/docs/spec.md#31-two-repos-two-jobs)):

- the **OS repository** (`kailash-os`) — the distribution flake: host
  modules, image matrix, the CLI, the menu. It never contains tool
  derivations.
- the **packages repository** (`kailash-packages`) — bespoke
  derivations, the overlay, and **the tool manifest**: the single
  hand-maintained registry ([the manifest section](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/docs/spec.md#42-the-tool-manifest--the-single-source-of-truth)).
  Every other view — category modules, desktop menu, CLI listing,
  generated docs, this guide's reference part — is generated from it.

## Pins and locks

No package floats:

- Bespoke tools are pinned upstream (`nvfetcher`) and committed with
  content hashes. A pin changes only together with the manifest entry
  it belongs to — never by hand in the sources directory.
- Pins carry an **update class** (fast-moving tools are checked
  weekly, steady ones fortnightly, nixpkgs-native packages ride the
  nixpkgs refresh only). Automated checks open update PRs only when
  the new revision passes its smoke check — freshness never lands
  unreviewed.
- The `nixpkgs` lock stays put between scheduled refreshes. **The
  lockfile is the version**: nothing re-links, re-installs or
  re-downloads in the background. Everything — the OS, the tools, the
  menu, the docs — is expressed in flakes, with no state outside the
  store and no imperative install steps to drift an environment.

## Software-only posture

The classic layer is software-only by scope: no hardware-hacking,
wifi/RF or Bluetooth attack stacks ship (the SDR niche stays opt-in
because signal datasets feed ML research). Network-infrastructure
exploitation arsenals and social-engineering packs are excluded — the
distribution re-aims the integrated-distro shape at the AI-security
pillar set rather than porting Kali's full inventory.
